items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo became Mackenzie Health’s President and Chief Executive Officer on April 13, 2026.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health tribute marking Mary-Agnes Wilson’s final day
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health publicly thanked Mary-Agnes Wilson on her final day with the organization, stating that she had completed nine months as Interim President and CEO and approximately eight years with Mackenzie Health.

items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health appointed Dr. David Rauchwerger as Chief of Staff, effective December 15, 2025.

items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: The announcement thanked outgoing Chief of Staff Dr. Steven Jackson for his decade of service in the role.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health CEO appointment announcement; Canadian Healthcare Technology coverage
items.verbatim_snippet: Mackenzie Health announced that Carmine Stumpo would become its next President and CEO, effective April 13, 2026.

items.citation_text: Welcoming the new Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey was appointed Chair of Mackenzie Health’s Board of Directors at the June 19, 2025 Annual General Meeting.

items.citation_text: Board-chair transition from Stephanie Zee to John Fursey
items.verbatim_snippet: Stephanie Zee left the Chair position when John Fursey was appointed at the June 19, 2025 AGM.

items.citation_text: Mackenzie Health announcement identifying outgoing board members
items.verbatim_snippet: In the announcement naming John Fursey as Board Chair, Mackenzie Health expressly identified Fay Lim-Lambie and Ruby Philip-Katyal as outgoing board members and thanked them for their leadership, vision, and support.
